meta.title: Shipment & Compliance Document Upload: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role on the specified Enterprise tenant
Open an ASN and attempt to upload the packing list, e-way bill, and LR/AWB through Shipment & Compliance Document Upload
